524 Mt at 0.31% TREO

Cummins Range Mineral Resource The metallurgical testwork reported in this announcement is conducted against the backdrop of a substantial, defined Mineral Resource. As updated and announced on 25 January 2024 (ASX: REE), the Cummins Range Mineral Resource Estimate (MRE) was prepared by ERM Consultants Australia in accordance with the JORC Code 2012. At a 2.5% P2O5 cut-off grade, the combined MRE totals 524 Mt at 0.31% TREO (3,120 ppm) and 4.6% P2O5, containing 1.6 million tonnes of TREO and approximately 24 million tonnes of P2O5. Cummins Range is Australia’s largest undeveloped rare earths project.

278.8 Mt at 483 ppm TREO

The updated MRE totals 278.8 Mt at 483 ppm TREO and introduces a maiden 70.7 Mt Measured category, with Measured and Indicated Resources totalling 154.8 Mt. The high-grade domain of 53.3 Mt at 1,024 ppm TREO retained ~97% of its August 2025 tonnage and ~99% of its grade, while Measured and Indicated high-grade tonnage increased 7.2% to 38.0 Mt. The update incorporated 83 drill holes for 4,378 m, including 20 twin holes that confirmed existing results.

278.8 Mt at 483 ppm TREO

The updated MRE totals 278.8 Mt at 483 ppm TREO and introduces a maiden 70.7 Mt Measured category, with Measured and Indicated Resources totalling 154.8 Mt. The high-grade domain of 53.3 Mt at 1,024 ppm TREO retained ~97% of its August 2025 tonnage and ~99% of its grade, while Measured and Indicated high-grade tonnage increased 7.2% to 38.0 Mt. The update incorporated 83 drill holes for 4,378 m, including 20 twin holes that confirmed existing results.
